# Waleed Property

> Independent Oman real-estate advice for foreign and GCC investors, by Waleed Al Abri, a licensed real estate advisor in Muscat. Verified prices, current law (2026), and straight answers on ownership, residency, and off-plan safety. Consultations via WhatsApp: +968 79136646.

Waleed Property publishes verified, dated answers to the questions foreign buyers actually ask about Oman property. All legal content cites the current laws: Royal Decree 79/2025 (Real Estate Regulation Law, in force 10 March 2026, replacing RD 30/2018) and ROP Decision 87/2026 (owner residency, effective 22 June 2026). Pages are re-verified quarterly.
